project.name: Kujo VideoOps
project.tagline: The stage performs bounded work; the system proves acceptance.

cards.title: PLANNING_READY
cards.tagline: Five validated files, one explicit handoff.
cards.caption: VideoOps makes creative intent inspectable before media work begins.

cards.title: REVISION_REQUIRED
cards.caption: A failed draft becomes a bounded repair, not a pipeline restart.

cards.title: APPROVED
cards.caption: Economical inference is acceptable when explicit gates prove the artifact.

cards.title: BLOCKED
cards.tagline: Missing rights or required inputs stop only the affected path.
cards.caption: VideoOps fails closed when a required asset or its rights evidence is unresolved.

cards.title: STAGE_ESCALATED
cards.tagline: Only the failing stage may cross the economical boundary.
cards.caption: Escalation is stage-local, justified by a failed gate, and recorded.

cards.title: REVISION_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED
cards.tagline: Three failed cycles stop automated revision.
cards.caption: VideoOps asks for human intervention instead of looping indefinitely.
